summary: Iteration 27 backend test suite covering 5 new features. 18/21 tests PASS (85.7%). Confirmed: Group Leveling meta fields (level/color/badge/title/xp_into_level/xp_for_next/next_tier/champion_title) present on /api/groups and /api/groups/{id}; /api/group-challenge shape correct and non-admin gets 403 on start/finalize while admin gets 400 when a challenge is already active; verified gym toggle works and surfaces in /api/gyms directory + /api/profile/gym-rank (gym_verified); gym logo upload accepts PNG (returns logo_media_id and surfaces in directory) and rejects text/plain with 400; non-admin gets 403 on both admin gym endpoints; PATCH /api/profile/update normalizes social_youtube full URL and @handle to a bare handle; /api/exercises returns 172 items with new categories Powerlifting/Strongman/Calisthenics/CrossFit; /api/exercises/demo?name= returns instantly (<0.2s) with {name, media_id (nullable)} — no 502 or hang; /api/enhanced/peds returns 39 PEDs including Masteron, Anadrol, MK-677, Tesamorelin. FAILURE: is_creator is not returned by /api/profile/me or /api/auth/me even though social_youtube is stored — spec requires is_creator to be true when any tiktok/instagram/youtube is set. is_creator IS correctly returned by /api/users/{id}/public.

minor.issue: is_creator field is not computed/returned on /profile/me or /auth/me. Spec: 'is_creator is true when any of tiktok/instagram/youtube is set'. Currently only /api/users/{id}/public computes it (via routes/profile.py line 282). /profile/me (routes/profile.py:6-10) and /auth/me (routes/auth.py:101-107) just return the raw user doc which never had is_creator persisted. Fix: compute is_creator = bool(u.get('social_tiktok') or u.get('social_instagram') or u.get('social_youtube')) inside profile_me() and me().

action_items: Fix /api/profile/me and /api/auth/me to include is_creator = bool(social_tiktok or social_instagram or social_youtube). Simplest fix: add two lines inside profile_me() and me() before return, e.g. `user['is_creator'] = bool(user.get('social_tiktok') or user.get('social_instagram') or user.get('social_youtube'))`. This is required by the feature spec so the frontend can gate the creator UI off the same endpoint it already reads for the current user.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/profile.py: /profile/me returns the raw user doc directly — any future computed field (is_creator, is_founder etc.) has to be added by hand. Consider a small serializer helper that both /profile/me and /auth/me pass through so computed fields stay in sync.

routes/groups.py: award_group_xp is called from workout logging and the standings diff is computed against a start_snapshot — verified indirectly via the returned meta on /api/groups. Non-admin start/finalize correctly 403 (via _require_admin_u).

rca_of_issue: Bug: is_creator missing from /profile/me and /auth/me. Root cause: routes/profile.py:6-10 and routes/auth.py:101-107 return the user doc as stored in Mongo. is_creator is a *computed* field (true if any social handle is set) — it's only computed in the public serializer at routes/profile.py:282. Since it was never persisted onto the user doc, the two 'me' endpoints simply don't have it. Reproduction: PATCH /api/profile/update {social_youtube:'https://www.youtube.com/@TestHandle'} → GET /api/profile/me → response has social_youtube='TestHandle' but no is_creator key. Fix: compute it inline in both endpoints (see action_items).
